review_candidates.title: Senior UI/UX Designer – Ecommerce Marketplace
review_candidates.description: Senior UI/UX Designer – Ecommerce Marketplace Cairo, Egypt Full-time | On-site EGP 34,000 to 38,000 per month Fluent English Required About Iryss Iryss is the first omnichannel B2C and B2B fashion marketplace for SME brands. We help independent fashion and beauty labels grow globally through a connected ecosystem that combines retail, wholesale, dropshipping, content, and logistics in one platform. Backed by European investors, Iryss is building the next generation of commerce for independent brands, with offices in Cairo and Milan. The Role We are looking for an experienced Senior UI/UX Designer to join the existing Iryss product and development team. You will help design and shape the user experience across the Iryss B2C and B2B marketplace platforms, including customer facing storefronts, ecommerce journeys, dashboards, onboarding flows, product management systems, and operational tools. This role requires strong UI and UX skills with a focus on creating modern, intuitive, and visually polished ecommerce experiences across both web and mobile environments. We are looking for someone with strong visual instincts, proven experience designing ecommerce and marketplace platforms, and the ability to simplify complex workflows into clear and intuitive interfaces. This is a demanding role within a fast moving product environment and requires someone who is self motivated, organised, and comfortable taking ownership of projects from concept through to implementation. You should be comfortable collaborating closely with developers and product teams throughout the design and implementation process while maintaining a high standard of design quality across the platform. Responsibilities Design ecommerce and dashboard experiences across customer, seller, reseller, and admin environments Create wireframes, mockups, prototypes, UI layouts, and UX flows in Figma Design clear and intuitive user journeys across complex workflows Improve usability, navigation, and consistency across the platform Design responsive experiences across both desktop and mobile environments Work closely with developers during implementation and refinement Review completed features and refine the overall user experience Qualifications 3 to 6 years of UI/UX design experience Strong portfolio showing ecommerce, marketplace, SaaS, or dashboard work Advanced Figma skills Proven experience designing modern ecommerce or marketplace platforms Strong understanding of ecommerce usability, user behaviour, and customer journeys Strong understanding of modern ecommerce UI patterns and customer expectations Experience designing responsive web and mobile interfaces Experience working with design systems and component based UI Experience collaborating with React or Next.js development teams Strong attention to detail and interface consistency Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams Ability to work independently and deliver consistently in a fast moving environment Fluent English communication skills To Apply Please send your CV, portfolio, and examples of relevant UI/UX work. We are looking for someone with proven experience designing modern ecommerce platforms and a strong eye for clean, intuitive user experiences.

review_candidates.title: Senior Landscape Architecture BIM French speaker
review_candidates.description: Company Description ECB – Engineering Consulting Bureau is a fast-growing engineering and consultancy firm established in 1997, offering multidisciplinary services across diverse sectors. The company combines deep knowledge of Egypt’s market with international exposure to deliver client-focused solutions. ECB’s culture emphasizes collaboration, technical excellence, and responsiveness to client needs. Its management systems in design, site supervision, and project management comply with ISO 9001:2015, ensuring consistent quality and reliability. Team members join a professional environment that supports development, innovation, and high-performance standards. Role Description The Senior Landscape Architecture BIM French speaker role is a full-time, on-site position based in Qesm 2nd 6 October. The role involves leading landscape architectural designs within a BIM environment, preparing and reviewing detailed drawings, models, and documentation for projects. Daily tasks include coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, integrating landscape elements such as planting, hardscape, and irrigation systems into BIM models, and ensuring compliance with project standards and local regulations. The person in this role will communicate with French-speaking partners and clients, participate in design reviews, and provide technical guidance to junior staff. The position also involves overseeing landscape implementation aspects, supporting site teams with design clarifications, and contributing to continuous improvement of BIM workflows. Qualifications Landscape Design and Landscaping skills, with experience in developing conceptual and detailed landscape plans. Landscape Maintenance and Gardening skills to ensure practical, sustainable, and maintainable design solutions. Irrigation knowledge to integrate efficient water management systems into landscape projects. Strong BIM proficiency (e.g., Revit, Civil 3D, or similar tools) for landscape architecture modeling and coordination. Professional experience in landscape architecture, ideally in consultancy or multidisciplinary project environments. Fluency in French and good command of English to communicate effectively with international stakeholders. Relevant degree in Landscape Architecture, Architecture, or Civil Engineering, or an equivalent field. Ability to work on-site in Qesm 2nd 6 October, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects. Familiarity with quality standards and project delivery processes; knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 practices is an advantage.
